question: A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. Sam eats 3 slices. What fraction of the pizza did Sam eat?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: How many slices did Sam eat, and how many slices make up the whole pizza?

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Sam ate 3 slices out of 8 total, so I think the fraction is 3/8.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: That's right. Can you explain why the denominator is 8?

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Because the whole pizza was cut into 8 equal slices, so 8 is the total number of parts.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: What is the first step to isolate x?

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: I'm not sure, this is confusing. Can I get a hint?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Sure -- try subtracting 5 from both sides first.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: OK so 2x = 8, and then x = 4? I think that's the same as dividing both sides by 2.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Which digit tells you whether to round up or down?

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: The ones digit is 7, so I round up. That makes it 350.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Good. What if the number were 342 instead?

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Then the ones digit is 2, so I round down to 340.
